clue.text: Pull back, defended by bullets and drones

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word for pull from right to left
something defended by guards sits inside them, so one word goes within the other

blocks.note: to pull is to drag
slugs is slang for bullets

explanation.surface: A retreat covered by gunfire and unmanned aircraft overhead, like a military withdrawal.
explanation.walkthrough: Drones look like aircraft beside the bullets, but here they are idle people.
explanation.definitionFit: A drone is a lazy idler who lives off others' work, which is exactly what sluggards are.

clue.text: Unworthy sailor first to board? Nervous about that

indicators.note: first picks out only the opening letter of the following word
about means the word for nervous wraps around everything that came before

blocks.note: AB, able seaman, is the usual crossword sailor
opening letter of board
shy means timid or nervous

explanation.surface: A sailor seems unfit to be first aboard ship and is nervous about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Shabby behaviour is mean and dishonourable, so it is unworthy of a decent person.

clue.text: Church damaged and left in penury, damaged as never before

indicators.note: the second damaged says the word penury is knocked out of shape and rearranged
in places the church, damaged and left pieces inside the rearranged penury

blocks.note: CE is the Church of England
damaged here means dented
simply joins the pieces
L is the abbreviation for left
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A church left impoverished and damaged to a degree never seen before.
explanation.walkthrough: The first damaged supplies a word; the second one is the anagram signal for penury.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done as never before has no precedent, which is the meaning of the adverb.

clue.text: Information on contents of boat in port

indicators.note: contents of means only the inside letters of the next word are kept

blocks.note: gen is British slang for information
the inner letters of boat

explanation.surface: Details about what a boat in harbour is carrying.
explanation.walkthrough: On places the first piece before the second in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Genoa is a major Italian seaport on the Ligurian coast, an example of a port.

clue.text: Ring with piece of advice about river excursion

indicators.note: about means the piece of advice goes around the river abbreviation

blocks.note: a ring is round, and a round is a circle
a tip is a helpful hint
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Someone phones with a tip about a river outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A round trip is a journey out and back again, which is what an excursion is.

clue.text: Say nothing about king in film about ogre

blocks.note: sh is the instruction to keep quiet
re means about or concerning
K is king in chess notation

explanation.surface: Keeping quiet about a monarch appearing in a fairy-tale film.
explanation.walkthrough: The first about supplies letters; the second belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrek is the 2001 animated DreamWorks feature whose green swamp-dwelling hero is an ogre.

clue.text: Annoying person with love for sauce

blocks.note: a pest is a nuisance
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: An irritating person who adores a particular sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Pesto is the Italian basil, pine nut and garlic paste served on pasta.

clue.text: Friend with a piece of furniture that's pleasing

blocks.note: a pal is a friend
taken as written
a table is furniture

explanation.surface: A friend owns a handsome piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Palatable food or ideas are agreeable and acceptable, so pleasing to taste or mind.

clue.text: Fashion designer in centre sat calmly working

indicators.note: working suggests the letters are busy moving about into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: A designer sitting quietly in the middle of a busy studio.
explanation.definitionFit: Stella McCartney, daughter of Paul, is a British designer with her own fashion label.

clue.text: Basket emptied into river? That's stupid

indicators.note: emptied removes the inside, leaving only the outer letters
into puts the emptied basket inside the river

blocks.note: the Ouse is a river in England, a crossword favourite
the first and last letters of basket

explanation.surface: Tipping out a basket into a river would be a foolish act.
explanation.definitionFit: Obtuse describes someone slow to understand, so dull-witted or stupid.

clue.text: Tree in a small enclosure

blocks.note: taken as written
S is the abbreviation for small
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A tree growing in a little fenced pen.
explanation.definitionFit: The aspen is a poplar species known for leaves that tremble in the slightest breeze.

clue.text: Most disobedient? Sure, until reformed

indicators.note: reformed means formed again, so the letters take a new shape

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The naughtiest child stays that way, surely, until they mend their ways.
explanation.walkthrough: Reformed fits the surface of a wrongdoer turning good, which disguises the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Unruly means hard to control, and its superlative describes the hardest of all to discipline.

clue.text: Fun? Worker perhaps worries about various kinds

indicators.note: various suggests a mixture, so these letters come in a different order
about means the worries word goes around the mixed letters

blocks.note: a worker is one kind of bee, hence perhaps
to rattle someone is to unsettle them
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A worker frets over all sorts of things and wonders where the fun went.
explanation.walkthrough: Perhaps signals that a worker is only an example of a bee.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer and skittles is a British idiom for pleasure and amusement, as in 'life is not all beer and skittles'.

clue.text: Note and support thrust in message

blocks.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
a leg supports a table or chair
to ram is to thrust forcefully

explanation.surface: A written note with backing and a forceful point in a message.
explanation.definitionFit: A telegram was a message sent by telegraph and delivered on paper.

clue.text: Politician put in effort, right away, to obtain freedom

indicators.note: right away means that letter is sent off and dropped from the word
put in places the politician inside the shortened word

blocks.note: exertion is effort
R is the abbreviation for right
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician works hard, and at once, to win his liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: An exemption is release from a duty or rule that others must obey, a kind of freedom.

clue.text: Tangle with learner in game that's unique

indicators.note: in places the learner letter inside the name of the game

blocks.note: to mat is to tangle, as hair does
chess is a board game
L is the learner plate on a car

explanation.surface: A novice gets tied up in knots during a one-of-a-kind game.
explanation.definitionFit: Matchless means without equal, so it has no rival or match, just as unique things have none.

clue.text: Hesitation in lead about to cause collision

indicators.note: about means the symbol for lead is turned around
in puts the hesitation sound inside the other piece

blocks.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
um is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A moment of hesitation while leading a race is about to cause a crash.
explanation.walkthrough: Lead looks like being in front, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A bump is a minor knock or impact between two things, a small collision.

clue.text: Speaker's beginning? Give up

indicators.note: a speaker's version is the word as heard, not as written

blocks.note: a seed is the beginning of something

explanation.surface: The Speaker of the House opens proceedings by announcing a surrender.
explanation.walkthrough: Speaker's suggests the Speaker of the Commons, but it only means the word is heard.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede territory or rights is to surrender or yield them, so give up.

clue.text: Join knight in step showing restraint

indicators.note: in places the join word and knight inside the word for step

blocks.note: a pace is a step
to tie is to join
N is the knight in chess notation

explanation.surface: Fall into step with a knight and show self-control.
explanation.definitionFit: Patience is calm tolerance of delay or provocation, a form of self-restraint.

clue.text: Elegant plot, if speedy, having lost regular characters

indicators.note: losing regular characters drops every other letter, keeping the rest

blocks.note: first, third, fifth letters and so on

explanation.surface: A neat, elegant story becomes hurried and loses some of its characters.
explanation.definitionFit: Poised means composed and graceful in bearing, so elegant in manner.

clue.text: One working on paper painted it orange in part

indicators.note: in part says the letters sit within a stretch of the clue words

blocks.note: letters run across the end of painted, it, and the start of orange

explanation.surface: Someone at work on paper painted part of it orange.
explanation.walkthrough: Paper sounds like art paper, but it is a newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor works on a newspaper, preparing and choosing what goes into print.

clue.text: Elated, excited to hold pet for now

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up and jumble into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: Thrilled and excited to be looking after a pet for the time being.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on top of the world is an idiom for feeling extremely happy, so elated.

clue.text: Combined force, not new

blocks.note: F is the symbol for force in physics
used goods are second-hand, not new

explanation.surface: A combined force of troops that has already seen action.
explanation.definitionFit: Fused things have been joined or melted together into one, so combined.

clue.text: Alien upset in struggle to become liquid

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the alien word over, so it reads backwards
in places the turned alien inside the word for struggle

blocks.note: ET is the film alien
a war is a struggle

explanation.surface: An alien in a science-fiction battle dissolves into liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: Water is the commonest liquid of all, a clear fluid that falls as rain.

clue.text: Incidental topic in publication backing team

indicators.note: backing means coming behind, so the publication follows the team

blocks.note: a side is a sports team
an issue is one publication of a magazine

explanation.surface: A minor subject covered in a magazine that supports a football club.
explanation.walkthrough: Backing reads as supporting the team, but it places one word after the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A side issue is a subsidiary matter, of secondary importance to the main question.

clue.text: Belief expressed with energy in shelter

indicators.note: in places the energy letter inside the word for shelter

blocks.note: a tent is a shelter
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A conviction voiced forcefully under canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or doctrine held as true by a person or group.

clue.text: Party longing for respected figure

blocks.note: a do is a party
a yen is a yearning

explanation.surface: Someone at a party yearning for an esteemed guest to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: A doyen is the most senior and esteemed member of a group or profession.

clue.text: Cause of devastation in ancient city surrounded by endless wasteland

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off
surrounded by puts the city inside the shortened wasteland word

blocks.note: a desert is a wasteland
Troy is the ancient city of Homer

explanation.surface: An ancient city ruined and lost in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: Troy's fall fits the devastation picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A destroyer is anything that wrecks or ruins, so it causes devastation.
